newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Big Nasdaq 100 position closed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Big Nasdaq 100 position closed.

text.p: An institutional investor closed a big position in October Nasdaq 100 stock index options, traders said Monday.
The October 730 call, 755 call and 735 call each traded about 10,000 contracts.
At 1415 CDT (1915 GMT), the Nasdaq 100 was down 2.86 points at 741.87.
"I believe it was a customer closing that," one trader said of the heavy activity in the options. "He had sold it a couple of days prior."
The trader said the investor had bought the puts and sold the call spread several days ago.
"The index has since backed off and I think (the investor) was just taking a quick profit," the trader said.

The October 730 call, which was down 1-3/4 at 26-1/4, had open interest of 10,675. The October 755 call, down 1-1/2 at 10-3/8, had open interest of 10,035, and the October 735 put, down 1-3/4 at 10-3/4, had open interest of about 10,165.
Few other NDX options were busy, with the next most active being the October 750 put, which traded 500 contracts.
The October 740 call and put traded 327 contracts each.
Traders said the same investor apparently closed out similar positions in both the S&P 100 index .OEX and S&P 500 index .SPX.
On the OEX, the most active option was the October 640 call, which traded more than 13,600 contracts.
With the OEX spot index up 2.75 points at 663.83, the October 640 call was ahead 2-1/4 at 28-1/4. Its open interest was roughly 25,390.
Also on the call side, the October 660 traded about 6,400 contracts, the October 665 nearly 7,000 and the October 670 6,600.
The October 660 put traded nearly 9,100 contracts. The option was down 5/8 at 7-7/8 and had open interest of 16,570.
On the SPX, the most active option was the October 660 put, with about 8,600 contracts traded. The October 675 put traded 7,700 and the October 680 put traded 4,230.
Among calls, the SPX October 690 traded 3,000, making it the most active SPX call. The November 705 call traded nearly 2,500.
The SPX spot index was up 1.30 at 687.49 in late trade.
